description.narrative: The proposed IFC investment is a financing package of up to US$112.5 million, composed by an A-loan of up to US$66 million for IFCs own account, a B1-loan of up to US$31.5 million, and a parallel loan of up to US$15 million. The proposed financing package intends to support the development of a US$205.5 million agro-industrial complex, including soybean crushing plant and warehouses at Berth 4 of the Umm Qasr Port in Iraq (the Project). The project will have a full corporate guarantee from Tiryaki Agro Gida Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S. (Tiryaki or the Sponsor) which is a leading agricultural commodity trading company in Türkiye. Sama Al-Manar for General Trading Company (the Project Company) of which Tiryaki is a shareholder, will execute the Project. Tiryaki is a previous IFC portfolio client, with 2 previous transactions.

the Project is expected to contribute to improved food security for consumers through increasing the availability of maize and soybean meal to support poultry production in Iraq, and to generate economy wide effects through employment creation, value addition, and contribution to economic and export diversification. Beyond the Project, IFC anticipates that its financing, as part of IFCs Global Food Security Platform, will promote greater resilience in the global food supply market.
